gitCommit.subject: Promo code and promoter card hold up at 320 px, in the dark theme, in a browser (0103)
gitCommit.body:
Promo code and promoter card hold up at 320 px, in the dark theme, in a browser (0103)

- The promo code's fieldset is a grid: its column is now minmax(0, 1fr), so at 320 px the
  six boxes shrink instead of pushing /apply sideways by 21 px (the site's own browser
  check caught it in EN, FR and AR).
- The promoter card's text takes the card's own ink: `.card p` (public.css) had given it the
  dark theme's light paragraph colour on the white card — contrast 1.88.
- Browser checks for the new pages: the promoters list, a promoter's page and card, the
  registration sources and /join in EN/FR/AR, light and dark, at 375, 320 px and desktop —
  axe, no sideways scroll, noindex, the token out of the address, no number or note on the
  card or the list; and the promo code typed in Arabic digits on /apply at 320 px, left to
  right.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
